note: Ratchets, not targets. Measured 2026-09-08 on commit 3cc349f65 and set 2 KB above each, so a regression fails and normal churn does not. The ubuntu-latest runner reads consistently ~0.4 KB HIGHER than macOS for the same commit (CI on e5c4dfa09: 323.8 / 324.7 / 322.2 / 327.9), so real headroom is about 1.6 KB, not 2. That is still a regression ratchet and widening it would weaken it. STEP 14 asks for 180 KB; the Next 16 client runtime alone is 130 KB, so 180 is not reachable by trimming app code and re-deriving it is an owner decision. Lower a number here whenever a real cut lands; never raise one without a line in docs/PERF-REPORT.md saying what grew and why.
